ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Our word had already been given' imply about the fate of the prophets?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of 'Tasbiq' (precedence), affirming that God's decisive word for the victory of the Messengers was established before their mission began, guaranteeing their ultimate success despite temporary trials. This divine decree not only validates the historical triumph of prophets like Muhammad (PBUH) but also serves as a theological foundation for the endurance of the Imams, who are viewed as the continuation of the prophetic mission. The verse thus provides believers with assurance that the path of truth is pre-ordained for victory, reinforcing the inevitability of divine justice.
